title: Talent market
description: The record is the evidence chain: read the resume and evidence, check fit against a position, then recruit.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or identity ID
filters.positionHint: Pick a position to attach a fit summary and sort by match — the unevaluated stay listed (Unknown ≠ Bad).

empty.title: No listed talents right now
empty.hint: Finish cultivating a character and list them on the market.

manage.title: My listings
manage.hint: Ready characters can be listed; active listings can be delisted anytime. Buyers judge quality from the record — there is no power score.

fit.title: Position fit
fit.pickPosition: Pick a position to see fit

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.hint: Every competency is backed by the record evidence below, traceable to its source.

recruit.title: Recruit {{name}}
recruit.description: They become an employee of your company: identity ID, personality, competencies, knowledge and evidence stay exactly as they are — nothing is copied or rewritten.
recruit.slotHint: Choosing a slot creates the position assignment in the same transaction; the department follows the slot.

reasons.listing_not_active: This talent was already recruited or delisted
reasons.already_employed: This talent already holds an active position
reasons.not_recruitable: This talent cannot be recruited right now
reasons.department_not_found: Department missing or not in your company
reasons.position_slot_not_found: Slot missing or not in your company
